subject: riscv: Fix hugetlb retrieval of number of ptes in case of !present pte
reason: 不在内存的大页表项不能从内容推大小；arm64先修，同一修复适用于RISC-V
note: 大页表项个数改用传入的大小参数，不再从可能不在内存的表项内容推出；照arm64的修复，但保留了!pte_napot门槛（之后运行确认留下了残留表项）

subject: riscv: kexec: Align the kexeced kernel entry
reason: kexec入口须按启动协议对齐（arm64同有）
note: kexec装载对齐从PAGE_SIZE改为启动协议要求的PMD_SIZE

subject: riscv: Fix module_alloc() that did not reset the linear mapping permissions
reason: 卸载模块须恢复线性映射权限（x86、arm64同用VM_FLUSH_RESET_PERMS）
note: module_alloc加VM_FLUSH_RESET_PERMS，卸载时恢复线性映射权限，与x86、arm64一致

subject: riscv: lib: Check if output in asm goto supported
reason: 编译器asm goto输出支持
note: 按编译器是否支持asm goto输出做条件编译，用公共的CC_HAS_ASM_GOTO_TIED_OUTPUT

subject: riscv: Fix vector state restore in rt_sigreturn()
reason: 信号返回恢复向量状态的顺序（arm64 FPSIMD惰性状态有同类规则）
note: 信号返回时先把向量状态标为已恢复再复制，避免被丢弃的状态覆盖；按RISC-V向量规范另行处理

subject: riscv, bpf: Fix incorrect runtime stats
reason: BPF trampoline运行统计（arm64 JIT同类修复）
note: trampoline中保存起始时间的指令提前到条件跳转之前；arm64有同样问题，同一组补丁一起修

subject: riscv: fix overlap of allocated page and PTR_ERR
counterpart: include/linux/err.h:IS_ERR_VALUE（最后一页地址与错误码重叠）
reason: 32位末页与ERR_PTR重叠（公共约定）
note: RV32把会映射到最后一页（与ERR_PTR重叠）的物理内存保留掉

subject: riscv, bpf: make some atomic operations fully ordered
reason: BPF原子操作须完全有序
note: BPF带FETCH的原子操作、XCHG改为aq/rl完全有序，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: force PAGE_SIZE linear mapping if debug_pagealloc is enabled
reason: debug_pagealloc须页粒度线性映射（arm64同）
note: 开启debug_pagealloc时线性映射强制用页粒度，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: kexec: Avoid deadlock in kexec crash path
reason: 中断上下文中kexec崩溃路径死锁（说明中对比arm64）
note: 删掉kexec崩溃路径中会取锁的irq_set_irqchip_state；说明写明“与arm64不同，RISC-V只需EOI”

subject: riscv: entry: always initialize regs->a0 to -ENOSYS
reason: 系统调用号为-1时a0须为-ENOSYS（公共ptrace约定）
note: 系统调用入口始终先把a0置为-ENOSYS，与arm64一致

subject: riscv/mm: Add handling for VM_FAULT_SIGSEGV in mm_fault_error()
reason: 公共缺页代码返回VM_FAULT_SIGSEGV须由架构处理
note: 缺页错误处理补上VM_FAULT_SIGSEGV分支，与x86一致

subject: riscv, bpf: Make BPF_CMPXCHG fully ordered
reason: BPF CMPXCHG须完全有序
note: BPF CMPXCHG的sc加rl位，完全有序

subject: riscv: Fixup boot failure when CONFIG_DEBUG_RT_MUTEXES=y
reason: 早期启动关中断时不能取mutex
note: 早期启动关中断时jump_label改指令不取text_mutex；arm64本来就不取锁，RISC-V另加早期分支

subject: riscv: Fix wrong usage of __pa() on a fixmap address
reason: __pa只适用于线性映射（dtb在fixmap）
note: dtb在fixmap上，改用保存的物理地址，不再对fixmap地址用__pa()

subject: RISC-V: KVM: Disable the kernel perf counter during configure
reason: perf计数器创建时须禁用（arm64 KVM PMU同）
note: KVM创建perf计数器时设attr.disabled，与arm64 KVM一致

subject: RISC-V: KVM: Teardown riscv specific bits after kvm_exit
reason: 卸载顺序须与公共kvm_exit一致
note: KVM模块卸载时先kvm_exit再拆RISC-V专有部分，符合公共kvm_exit的顺序

subject: riscv: misaligned: enable IRQs while handling misaligned accesses
reason: 来自用户态的陷入处理中访问用户内存须开中断
note: 来自用户态的非对齐陷入处理中先开中断，再访问用户内存

subject: mm/ptdump: take the memory hotplug lock inside ptdump_walk_pgd()
reason: ptdump遍历与内存热拔并发；arm64、RISC-V、s390同样只在debugfs路径加锁，check_wx路径漏了
note: 内存热插拔锁从各架构的debugfs路径移到公共ptdump_walk_pgd，使check_wx路径也受保护；各架构原来都漏

subject: RISC-V: KVM: Remove automatic I/O mapping for VM_PFNMAP
reason: 公共vfio改变vm_pgoff语义
note: 删掉按vm_pgoff推算物理地址的预先IO映射（公共vfio改了vm_pgoff的含义），改为缺页时按需映射

subject: RISC-V: KVM: Skip THP support check during dirty logging
reason: 脏页记录时须强制页粒度（arm64 KVM同）
note: 脏页记录时不再调整为透明大页映射，与arm64 KVM一致

subject: riscv: patch: Avoid early phys_to_page()
reason: 公共sparse_init后移（arm64同修8d09e2d569f6）
note: patch_map直接用物理地址，不在sparse_init之前用phys_to_page；照arm64的同类修复

subject: RISC-V: KVM: Fix lost write protection on huge pages during dirty logging
reason: 大页写保护须覆盖整块
note: 写保护去掉“剩余长度不小于页大小”的条件并把地址向下对齐，使大页总被写保护

subject: RISC-V: KVM: Fix ebreak self test failure
reason: KVM_SET_GUEST_DEBUG语义（公共KVM接口）
note: KVM_SET_GUEST_DEBUG补调用配置函数，使设置真正生效

subject: riscv: kexec_file: Fix crashk_low_res not exclude bug
reason: crashkernel低端区间排除（arm64先做）
note: kexec_file准备内核转储头时补上排除crashk_low_res，照arm64

subject: riscv: Prevent NULL pointer dereference in machine_kexec_prepare()
reason: IMA产生空buf
note: machine_kexec_prepare跳过buf为空的段（IMA会产生空缓冲区）

subject: RISC-V: KVM: Allow memslots ending at the GPA limit
reason: memslot边界（与其他架构一致）
note: memslot上界比较由>=改为>，与其他架构的KVM一致

subject: riscv: put interrupt entries into .irqentry.text
reason: kprobes约定：异常入口须放在.irqentry.text以免被探测；x86已遵守
note: 异常入口放进.irqentry.text节，使kprobes不探测，与x86一致

subject: riscv: provide riscv-specific is_trap_insn()
reason: 公共默认is_trap_insn只认uprobe用的断点指令，RISC-V有ebreak与c.ebreak两种，需自己实现（powerpc已自行实现）
note: 覆盖公共默认is_trap_insn，同时认ebreak和c.ebreak（powerpc也自行实现）

subject: kexec: fix KEXEC_FILE dependencies
reason: kexec_file与CRYPTO依赖的公共约定统一；RISC-V原依赖只挂在purgatory上，CRYPTO=m时静默缺purgatory
note: KEXEC_FILE对CRYPTO_SHA256=y的依赖移到公共Kconfig；x86、s390原来也错

subject: riscv: Fix SMP when shadow call stacks are enabled
reason: 影子调用栈须在次核开MMU后、进入C代码前装载；RISC-V一条路径漏装、另一条在开MMU前装
note: 影子调用栈改在次核开启MMU之后装载，并补上spinwait路径，与arm64一致

subject: kexec: drop dependency on ARCH_SUPPORTS_KEXEC from CRASH_DUMP
reason: 公共Kconfig去掉CRASH_DUMP对KEXEC的依赖后，RISC-V nommu下VA_BITS未定义
note: 公共CRASH_DUMP去掉对ARCH_SUPPORTS_KEXEC的依赖，RISC-V把只在MMU下有的VA_BITS放进CONFIG_MMU

subject: riscv: Fix set_direct_map_default_noflush() to reset _PAGE_EXEC
reason: 恢复线性映射默认权限的公共约定；RISC-V恢复时没清执行位，留下可写可执行映射
note: 恢复线性映射默认权限时清除执行位，与x86、arm64一致

subject: riscv: Check if the code to patch lies in the exit section
reason: RISC-V的patch_map源自arm64，arm64已处理.exit.text，RISC-V落入vmalloc_to_page而崩溃
note: patch_map补上.exit.text的情况；照arm64的patch_map写时漏了这一分支

subject: RISC-V: Update AT_VECTOR_SIZE_ARCH for new AT_MINSIGSTKSZ
reason: 照arm64加AT_MINSIGSTKSZ，却没像arm64那样把auxv长度加一
note: 照arm64加AT_MINSIGSTKSZ时漏了把AT_VECTOR_SIZE_ARCH加一，补上

subject: riscv: tlb: fix __p*d_free_tlb()
reason: 释放中间级页表须经mmu_gather并刷新TLB；现有硬件不缓存非叶表项，后果被遮住
note: 释放中间级页表改为经mmu_gather延迟释放并刷新，与arm64一致

subject: arch/mm/fault: fix major fault accounting when retrying under per-VMA lock
reason: 公共代码允许在VMA锁下处理读缺页后，各架构缺页处理重试时须保留FAULT_FLAG_TRIED；所有架构同时漏
note: 公共缺页改为可在VMA锁下处理后，各架构重试时都漏设FAULT_FLAG_TRIED，同一提交一起补

subject: KVM: introduce CONFIG_KVM_COMMON
reason: 公共KVM依赖INTERVAL_TREE，arm64已选，RISC-V与LoongArch漏选
note: 新增公共KVM_COMMON统一选上INTERVAL_TREE等依赖；arm64原已选，RISC-V漏选

subject: riscv: Fix set_huge_pte_at() for NAPOT mapping
reason: NAPOT大页更新须先清空并刷新（arm64连续页同理）；多数硬件未实现或宽容，后果被遮住
note: NAPOT大页更新前补“清空—刷新”步骤，注释写明等同arm64的Break-Before-Make

subject: riscv: Fix hugetlb_mask_last_page() when NAPOT is enabled
reason: 公共默认只认PMD/PUD大小，RISC-V有NAPOT大小，需像arm64那样自己实现
note: 覆盖公共默认hugetlb_mask_last_page，加入NAPOT大小，与arm64一致

subject: riscv, bpf: Fix unpredictable kernel crash about RV64 struct_ops
reason: 公共改动让struct_ops的func_addr非空，x86同时改用BPF_TRAMP_F_INDIRECT，RISC-V仍按func_addr区分
note: struct_ops改按BPF_TRAMP_F_INDIRECT标志判断，不再看func_addr是否为空，与x86一致

subject: riscv: Flush the tlb when a page directory is freed
reason: mmu_gather释放了页表时须刷新；现有硬件不缓存非叶表项
note: mmu_gather释放了页表时也刷新TLB，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: Fix arch_tlbbatch_flush() by clearing the batch cpumask
reason: 批量刷新后须清空批次CPU集合；后果只是多发IPI
note: 批量刷新TLB后清空批次的CPU集合，与x86一致

subject: riscv: Fix arch_hugetlb_migration_supported() for NAPOT
reason: 公共默认只认PMD/PUD大页，NAPOT大小需自己实现
note: 覆盖公共默认arch_hugetlb_migration_supported，认NAPOT大小，与arm64一致

subject: membarrier: riscv: Add full memory barrier in switch_mm()
reason: membarrier要求写rq->curr后有完全屏障；x86等的切换路径本就隐含屏障，弱内存模型才暴露
note: switch_mm中按membarrier要求补完全内存屏障，沿用PowerPC已有的membarrier_arch_switch_mm机制

subject: riscv: add CALLER_ADDRx support
reason: 公共默认假设__builtin_return_address(n)对n>0可用，RISC-V不行，arm64已自己实现
note: 实现RISC-V自己的return_address，替代对n>0不可用的__builtin_return_address(n)；代码取自arm64

subject: Revert "riscv: mm: support Svnapot in huge vmap"
reason: 内核vmap部分解除时无法先清后刷拆分NAPOT组，撤回NAPOT vmap
note: 回退NAPOT vmap支持：部分解除映射时没有办法先清后刷拆分NAPOT组

subject: riscv: Fix pte_leaf_size() for NAPOT
reason: 公共默认按单页算叶子大小，NAPOT需像arm64连续页那样自定义
note: 覆盖公共默认pte_leaf_size，按NAPOT大小返回，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: Sparse-Memory/vmemmap out-of-bounds fix
reason: vmemmap未按内存起始地址偏移；常见内存起点小，越界不出现
note: vmemmap减去内存起始地址对应的页号，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: Fix syscall wrapper for >word-size arguments
reason: 系统调用包装须原样传寄存器；RISC-V自定义包装在RV32上按类型取参，64位参数占寄存器对时出错
note: RV32系统调用包装改按ulong参数别名，原样传寄存器，与公共syscalls.h的做法一致

subject: riscv, bpf: Fix kfunc parameters incompatibility between bpf and riscv abi
reason: BPF按零扩展传32位参数，RV64调用约定要求符号扩展；JIT调用内核函数时须转换
note: BPF调用内核函数时把32位参数按RV64调用约定做符号扩展，与LoongArch一致

subject: riscv: Fix warning by declaring arch_cpu_idle() as noinstr
reason: 选了ARCH_WANTS_NO_INSTR后，RCU已关闭的空闲函数须标noinstr
note: arch_cpu_idle标为noinstr，与s390一致

subject: riscv: Disable preemption when using patch_map()
reason: fixmap只刷本核TLB，使用期间不能迁移；arm64持自旋锁关中断，RISC-V改用text_mutex后可被抢占
note: 使用fixmap改代码期间关抢占，防止迁移到别的CPU；arm64用关中断的自旋锁达到同样效果

subject: riscv: rewrite __kernel_map_pages() to fix sleeping in invalid context
reason: debug_pagealloc的__kernel_map_pages可能在原子上下文调用；RISC-V经__set_memory取init_mm的mmap锁
note: __kernel_map_pages改用apply_to_existing_page_range，不再取可能睡眠的mmap锁，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: Fix early ftrace nop patching
reason: 改写代码后执行前须维护指令缓存；早期ftrace把nop改写后未刷新
note: 早期ftrace改写nop后补本核指令缓存刷新

subject: riscv: prevent pt_regs corruption for secondary idle threads
reason: 线程栈顶须留出pt_regs；主核已修，次核未跟上
note: 次核idle线程的栈顶留出pt_regs；主核早已这样修，次核没跟上

subject: riscv: Fix fully ordered LR/SC xchg[8|16]() implementations
reason: 完全有序的xchg须带屏障；8/16位LR/SC版本漏了，弱序硬件上才可能出现
note: 完全有序的8/16位LR/SC xchg补上屏障，与cmpxchg和arm64一致

subject: riscv: stacktrace: convert arch_stack_walk() to noinstr
reason: 照arm64加CALLER_ADDRx，却没带上arm64已有的禁止插桩
note: arch_stack_walk标为noinstr；照arm64加CALLER_ADDRx时没带上arm64已有的禁止插桩

subject: riscv: Fix linear mapping checks for non-contiguous memory regions
reason: 线性映射之外的内存须从memblock去掉；RISC-V用mem=上限判断，内存不连续时才出错
note: 按线性映射能覆盖的物理地址范围裁掉memblock，不再按mem=的总量判断，与arm64一致

subject: riscv, bpf: Fix out-of-bounds issue when preparing trampoline image
reason: 公共代码改为先算大小再生成后，试算与实际生成的im参数不同，RISC-V按立即数长度变长生成指令致越界
note: trampoline试算阶段按最长指令序列生成im地址，使试算大小不小于实际生成；RISC-V立即数指令变长，按自身情况处理

subject: riscv: patch: Flush the icache right after patching to avoid illegal insns
reason: 改写代码后须立即维护指令缓存，不能延迟到批量结束
note: 改代码后立即刷新指令缓存，不再延迟到批量结束

subject: riscv: define ILLEGAL_POINTER_VALUE for 64bit
reason: 公共毒化指针默认偏移0，64位架构应给不可映射的偏移；只影响安全加固，无可见故障
note: 64位定义ILLEGAL_POINTER_VALUE为不可映射的地址，与arm64一致

subject: RISC-V: Enable the IPI before workqueue_online_cpu()
reason: IPI须在CPU上线早期（STARTING阶段）开启；RISC-V SBI IPI放在ONLINE_DYN，公共workqueue改动后先用到IPI
note: SBI IPI改在CPU上线的STARTING阶段开启（公共头文件新增状态），与GIC一致

subject: riscv: Re-introduce global icache flush in patch_text_XXX()
reason: 上一修复误删全局指令缓存刷新
note: 补回上一次修复误删的全局指令缓存刷新

subject: riscv: mm: Do not restrict mmap address based on hint
reason: mmap提示地址的公共语义不应限制分配范围；RISC-V按提示收紧上界，内存还有却返回ENOMEM
note: 删掉按mmap提示地址收紧上界的逻辑，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: Fix RISCV_ALTERNATIVE_EARLY
counterpart: arch/arm64/kernel/pi/Makefile（MMU建立前运行的代码去掉ftrace插桩、用-fpie）
reason: 早期替代补丁阶段调用SBI，未开MMU不能插桩和重定位
note: 早期替代补丁中调用的SBI函数移到单独文件，去掉ftrace、KASAN插桩并用-fno-pie编译，与arm64早期代码一致

subject: riscv: Fix kernel stack size when KASAN is enabled
reason: 开KASAN时内核栈须加倍；RISC-V放在Kconfig默认值里，后开KASAN不生效
note: 开KASAN时栈加倍的逻辑从Kconfig默认值移到头文件，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: efi: Set NX compat flag in PE/COFF header
reason: EFI头的NX兼容标志，arm64已设置
note: EFI头设置NX_COMPAT标志，与arm64一致

subject: RISC-V: ACPI: fix early_ioremap to early_memremap
reason: ACPI表是内存不是设备，应按可缓存方式映射；RISC-V用early_ioremap，只在开启Svpbmt时读错
note: ACPI表映射由early_ioremap改为early_memremap，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: vdso: Prevent the compiler from inserting calls to memset()
reason: vDSO不能有动态重定位，须禁止编译器插入memset；只在编译器恰好插入时出错
note: vDSO编译加-fno-builtin，防止编译器插入memset调用，与arm64一致

subject: of/fdt: add dt_phys arg to early_init_dt_scan and early_init_dt_verify
reason: 公共代码对设备树地址用__pa，而arm64、RISC-V的设备树在fixmap中
note: 公共early_init_dt_scan增加物理地址参数，由各架构传入，不再对fixmap地址用__pa；arm64也有同样问题

subject: riscv: Fix sleeping in invalid context in die()
reason: 异常处理中的die不能睡眠，须用raw自旋锁；只在PREEMPT_RT下出错
note: die_lock改为raw自旋锁，PREEMPT_RT下不睡眠，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: mm: Do not call pmd dtor on vmemmap page table teardown
reason: vmemmap的PMD页表未经构造，拆除时不能调析构；只在热拔内存时走到
note: 拆除vmemmap的PMD页表时不调用析构（它从未构造过），与arm64一致

subject: riscv: Fix IPIs usage in kfence_protect_page()
reason: kfence保护页可能在关中断时调用，不能发IPI刷TLB；arm64用硬件广播刷新，不需要IPI
note: kfence保护页可能在关中断时调用，改为只刷本核TLB，不发IPI，与x86一致

subject: riscv: mm: Fix the out of bound issue of vmemmap address
reason: vmemmap基准须按内存段对齐；内存起点不对齐时才越界
note: vmemmap基准按内存段大小向下对齐，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: fgraph: Fix stack layout to match __arch_ftrace_regs argument of ftrace_return_to_handler
reason: 公共fgraph改为传ftrace_regs后，RISC-V返回桩的栈布局未按ftrace_regs排布
note: 函数图返回桩按ftrace_regs的偏移保存寄存器，与公共代码的新约定和arm64一致

subject: riscv: Properly export reserved regions in /proc/iomem
reason: /proc/iomem须标出与内存重叠的保留区；arm64、LoongArch早已修过，RISC-V未跟上
note: /proc/iomem补标与内存重叠的保留区，照arm64、LoongArch

subject: riscv: misaligned: fix sleeping function called during misaligned access handling
counterpart: arch/arm/mm/alignment.c:do_alignment（原先开中断的，先开中断再访问用户内存）
reason: 未对齐陷入处理中关中断访问用户内存会睡眠（本修复后被撤回）
note: 非对齐陷入中改用不会睡眠的copy_*_user_nofault；对应物的做法是先开中断，此修复后来被回退并改为开中断（见A344）

subject: riscv: uprobes: Add missing fence.i after building the XOL buffer
reason: uprobe的XOL缓冲写入后须刷新指令缓存；RISC-V沿用只刷数据缓存的写法，特定核上才出错
note: uprobe的XOL缓冲写入后补指令缓存刷新，与arm64一致

subject: RISC-V: vDSO: Correct inline assembly constraints in the getrandom syscall wrapper
reason: vDSO系统调用内联汇编约束；其他架构用"=r"，RISC-V用"+r"，只在Clang优化时出错
note: vDSO getrandom内联汇编的输出约束由"+r"改为"=r"，与其他架构一致

subject: Revert "riscv: Define TASK_SIZE_MAX for __access_ok()"
reason: TASK_SIZE_MAX须是真实用户地址上界；RISC-V设成LONG_MAX，公共GUP快速路径会接受非法地址
note: 回退把TASK_SIZE_MAX设为LONG_MAX的优化，恢复为真实用户地址上界

subject: riscv: cpu_ops_sbi: Use static array for boot_data
reason: 对percpu变量用__pa，假设percpu在线性映射中；按页分配percpu时在vmalloc区
note: 启动数据从percpu变量改为内核镜像中的静态数组，使__pa得到正确物理地址，与arm64一致（改数据存放位置）

subject: riscv: Enable interrupt during exception handling
reason: 处理用户态异常时应开中断再发信号；PREEMPT_RT下自旋锁会睡眠才出错
note: 处理来自用户态的异常时先开中断再发信号，与x86一致

subject: riscv: uaccess: fix __put_user_nocheck for unaligned accesses
reason: put_user写入宽度应由目标类型决定；RISC-V按值的类型，只在非对齐目标路径出错
note: 非对齐put_user按目标类型决定写入宽度，与x86一致

subject: riscv: use an atomic xchg in pudp_huge_get_and_clear()
reason: PUD大页取出并清空须原子；RISC-V加PUD THP时沿用通用非原子版本
note: PUD大页取出并清空改为原子xchg，与x86一致

subject: riscv: kexec: initialize kexec_buf struct
reason: 公共kexec_file给kexec_buf加字段且总被读取，各架构未初始化栈上结构
note: 栈上kexec_buf清零初始化；公共代码新增字段后各架构都没初始化

subject: riscv: kexec: Initialize kexec_buf struct
reason: 同上（同一补丁的另一份提交）
note: 同A190，同一补丁的另一份提交

subject: arch: copy_thread: pass clone_flags as u64
reason: clone3后标志为64位，各架构copy_thread用unsigned long，32位上截断
note: 各架构copy_thread中clone_flags由unsigned long改为u64，32位上不再截断；所有架构同时改

subject: riscv, bpf: Sign extend struct ops return values properly
reason: struct_ops返回值须按RV64调用约定符号扩展
note: struct_ops返回值按RV64调用约定符号扩展，与LoongArch一致

subject: riscv: kprobes: Fix probe address validation
reason: 校验探测地址应从最近的前一个符号开始解码；RISC-V从_text起，遇到字面量会失步
note: kprobe校验探测地址改从最近的前一个符号开始解码，不再从_text起，照x86

subject: riscv: Use an atomic xchg in pudp_huge_get_and_clear()
reason: 同A188（修订后再次提交）
note: 同A188的修订版，改用xchg，单核时不用原子操作，维护者注明照x86

subject: RISC-V: Define pgprot_dmacoherent() for non-coherent devices
reason: 公共默认把一致性DMA内存映射成IO属性，RISC-V开Svpbmt后应像arm64那样自定义；只影响性能
note: 定义pgprot_dmacoherent，覆盖公共默认的IO属性，与arm64一致

subject: riscv: stacktrace: Disable KASAN checks for non-current tasks
reason: 回溯其他任务的栈时须关KASAN检查；x86早已修过
note: 回溯其他任务的栈时改用不做KASAN检查的读取，照x86

subject: riscv, bpf: Fix incorrect usage of BPF_TRAMP_F_ORIG_STACK
reason: 公共BPF修复改动各架构标志用法时，把RISC-V的跳过入口改成了ORIG_STACK
note: 跳过被追踪函数入口补丁指令的判断，由BPF_TRAMP_F_ORIG_STACK改为BPF_TRAMP_F_CALL_ORIG，与x86一致

subject: riscv: boot: Always make Image from vmlinux, not vmlinux.unstripped
reason: 公共kbuild让vmlinux.unstripped带.modinfo后，RISC-V可重定位内核从它生成Image，镜像大小超出头部记录
note: Image总从vmlinux生成，不再从vmlinux.unstripped生成，与arm64一致

subject: KVM: riscv: Fix Spectre-v1 in APLIC interrupt handling
reason: 客户机可控的中断号下标须防推测越界；arm64、x86已做
note: APLIC中客体可控的中断号下标加array_index_nospec，照arm64、x86

subject: KVM: riscv: Fix Spectre-v1 in PMU counter access
reason: 客户机可控的计数器下标须防推测越界；x86已做
note: PMU计数器下标加array_index_nospec，照x86；但同一函数kvm_riscv_vcpu_pmu_ctr_cfg_match中的事件编号下标仍漏了（第十一节的疑点）

subject: riscv: Define __riscv_copy_{,vec_}{words,bytes}_unaligned() using SYM_TYPED_FUNC_START
reason: 间接调用的汇编函数须带CFI类型
note: 被间接调用的汇编函数改用SYM_TYPED_FUNC_START，带CFI类型，与arm64一致

subject: RISC-V: KVM: Fix sign extension for MMIO loads
reason: 模拟MMIO有符号读须符号扩展；设备返回负值时才出错
note: KVM模拟MMIO有符号读时改为算术右移，正确符号扩展，与arm64一致

subject: riscv/ptrace: Use USER_REGSET_NOTE_TYPE for REGSET_CFI
reason: 公共ELF转储改为要求regset带note名后，RISC-V新加的CFI regset仍用旧写法
note: CFI的regset改用USER_REGSET_NOTE_TYPE，符合公共ELF转储的新要求，与arm64一致

subject: KVM: riscv: Check hugetlb block mappings against memslot bounds
reason: KVM二级块映射须在memslot内且对齐；RISC-V只在THP路径检查，hugetlb路径漏了
note: hugetlb路径也检查G-stage块映射是否在memslot内且对齐；RISC-V原来只在THP路径检查，arm64两条路径都查

subject: arch/riscv: vdso: remove CFI landing pad from rt_sigreturn
counterpart: arch/arm64/kernel/vdso/sigreturn.S（不带BTI C，注释说明原因）
reason: sigreturn跳板开头不能加CFI着陆指令，否则展开器识别失败；arm64早已为BTI修过
note: 去掉rt_sigreturn开头的CFI着陆指令，照arm64去掉BTI C

subject: riscv: probes: save original sp in rethook trampoline
reason: rethook跳板保存的pt_regs须含原始sp；RISC-V未保存，只在kretprobe读栈时出错
note: rethook跳板保存的pt_regs补上原始sp，与x86一致

subject: riscv: vdso: Do not use LTO for the vDSO
reason: vDSO不能参与LTO，arm64已移除LTO选项
note: vDSO编译去掉LTO选项，与arm64一致

subject: riscv/mm: use physical alignment for vmemmap_start_pfn
reason: vmemmap对齐的单位混用
note: vmemmap起始页号的对齐量换算成物理地址单位（上一次修复混用了单位）

subject: riscv: acpi: Handle LPI architectural context loss flags
reason: 公共cpuidle改为调用架构钩子判断LPI上下文丢失，RISC-V未实现，退回返回0的桩
note: 实现arch_get_idle_state_flags，把LPI的计时器上下文丢失映射为CPUIDLE_FLAG_TIMER_STOP，与arm64一致

subject: riscv, bpf: Fix missing sign-ext for signed 1-byte and 2-byte kfunc args
reason: RV64调用约定要求有符号1、2字节参数符号扩展；此前被零扩展省略掩盖
note: kfunc有符号1、2字节参数也做符号扩展；补全A065只处理4字节的遗漏，与LoongArch一致

subject: bpf, riscv: Make arena support depend on ZACAS
reason: 公共range tree改用kmalloc_nolock后需128位cmpxchg；x86、arm64总有，RISC-V依赖可选ZACAS扩展
note: BPF arena支持改为检查是否有cmpxchg128（ZACAS扩展）；x86、arm64总有该能力，RISC-V需另加能力检查

subject: kdump: defer the insertion of crashkernel resources
reason: 改用通用crashkernel预留后，RISC-V与arm64的/proc/iomem父资源消失
note: 公共crashkernel预留把插入/proc/iomem资源推迟到early_initcall，使父资源先插入；arm64也有同样问题

subject: mm: recover pud_leaf() definitions in nopmd case
reason: x86清理时删掉了公共nopmd中的pud_leaf定义，arm64与RISC-V两级页表构建失败
note: 恢复公共nopmd头文件中被x86清理误删的pud_leaf定义，两级页表的arm64、RISC-V都受影响

subject: rust: make mutually exclusive with CFI_CLANG
reason: 开启CFI_CLANG时加载rust模块崩溃，arm64、RISC-V、x86同
note: RUST与CFI_CLANG互斥，各架构都会崩溃

subject: bpf: verifier: prevent userspace memory access
counterpart: arch/x86/net/bpf_jit_comp.c（x86 JIT早有用户地址防护）
reason: BPF_PROBE_MEM可能读到用户态地址；x86 JIT自带防护，RISC-V等没有，改由验证器统一加
note: 验证器为BPF_PROBE_MEM统一加用户地址防护；x86 JIT原来自带防护，RISC-V等没有

subject: randomize_kstack: Remove non-functional per-arch entropy filtering
reason: 各架构对栈随机化熵的过滤实际减少了混入的位数，RISC-V同

subject: randomize_kstack: Remove non-functional per-arch entropy filtering
reason: 同上（同一补丁另一份）
note: 同B444，同一补丁的另一份提交

subject: syscalls: fix compat_sys_io_pgetevents_time64 usage
reason: compat下io_pgetevents须用compat入口做符号扩展；parisc早已修，RISC-V等仍用原生入口
note: compat下io_pgetevents_time64改用compat入口做符号扩展，照parisc

subject: binfmt_flat: Fix corruption when not offsetting data start
counterpart: fs/binfmt_flat.c（不偏移数据段时仍初始化共享库指针数组）
reason: RISC-V专用的FLAT变体不留共享库指针空间，公共代码仍写入，破坏代码段末尾
note: 公共binfmt_flat在不偏移数据段的配置下不再初始化共享库指针数组；该变体只有RISC-V用

subject: drivers/perf: riscv: Align errno for unsupported perf event
reason: 不支持的perf事件类型应返回-ENOENT，其他实现如此，RISC-V返回别的错误码
note: RISC-V perf驱动对不支持的事件改返回-ENOENT，与其他实现一致（RISC-V专用驱动计为架构代码）

subject: PCI/MSI: Handle lack of irqdomain gracefully
counterpart: drivers/pci/msi/msi.c:pci_msi_setup_msi_irqs（无父域时走旧式回退并告警）
reason: 公共PCI/MSI假设没有MSI父域时可走旧式回退，RISC-V用层次化中断域不实现该回退
note: 公共PCI/MSI在没有MSI父域且不支持旧式回退时直接返回不支持，不再走旧式回退桩告警

subject: ubi: ubi_get_ec_info: Fix compiling error 'cast specifies array type'
reason: RISC-V的untagged_addr对数组参数强制转换报错，其他架构不报

subject: cpuidle: Init cpuidle only for present CPUs
reason: cpuidle驱动按possible CPU初始化而CPU设备只按present注册；nosmp时出错

subject: scripts: Do not strip .rela.dyn section

note: 公共rv监视器对只有64位time_t系统调用的平台（如RV32）按调用号是否定义做条件编译

subject: vdso/datastore: Gate time data behind CONFIG_GENERIC_GETTIMEOFDAY

subject: Fix CC_HAS_ASM_GOTO_OUTPUT on non-x86 architectures

subject: kbuild: Use '--strip-unneeded-symbol' for removing module device table symbols

subject: randomize_kstack: Maintain kstack_offset per task
counterpart: include/linux/randomize_kstack.h（要求关中断关抢占调用）；x86在关中断的退出路径中调用
reason: 栈随机化偏移按per-cpu维护，要求关中断调用；arm64、LoongArch、RISC-V在开中断时调用

subject: ALSA: pcm: Don't setup bogus iov_iter for silencing

subject: ACPI: processor_idle: Mark LPI enter functions as __cpuidle

subject: net/mlx5e: Fix publication race for priv->channel_stats[]
reason: 发布新条目与计数之间无屏障；x86强序遮住，弱序的RISC-V、arm64才出错
